rv.q: Jessica Lange brings stunning colors to the role of a woman clawing her way through fog. You can't take your eyes off her.
This is Ms. Redgrave's best work in years and among her best ever.
Even when she’s not around, you can’t help thinking about her, any more than the three angry, anxious men onstage can.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actor in a Play
Best Featured Actor in a Play

cn.t: Jessica Lange delivers a stunning, indelible performance that dominates this magnificently staged revival. Despite the nearly four-hour runtime, Kent's precise direction maintains tension and swift pacing, creating a soul-piercing production that lands with full force.
